Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649949. Filter to exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to compound_structures, and filter by assay chembl_id. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
